openings: The museum has finished with you for tonight.
The last door closes behind you without hurry.
Your walk is over. What follows is only what the rooms noticed.

eraLines.civic-time-expansion-era: The Civic Time Expansion Era expects you back. It is still holding a day with your name on it and no year to put it in.
eraLines.counterfactual-communications-boom: The Counterfactual Communications Boom keeps your line open. Somewhere a receiver is warm, and nobody in that kitchen has hung up.
eraLines.domestic-weather-memory-era: The Domestic Weather Memory Era files your future under shelter. Expect rain indoors, and a voice calling you in before the thunder.

tagPhrases.borrowed-time: carrying a day that was never yours to keep
tagPhrases.accruing-interest: quietly owing more than you agreed to spend
tagPhrases.edited-without-asking: amended in a record you were never shown
tagPhrases.quiet-refusal: declining something without ever raising your voice
tagPhrases.room-to-breathe: with more room around you than the corridor promised
tagPhrases.almost-recognized: known by something that cannot quite place your name
tagPhrases.another-life-answering: answered by a life you decided not to live
tagPhrases.line-left-open: with a line still open behind you
tagPhrases.future-already-calling: already expected somewhere eleven years ahead
tagPhrases.apology-not-required: released from an apology you had prepared
tagPhrases.weather-you-can-re-enter: able to step back into weather that has already passed
tagPhrases.shelter-returned: given back a hallway you were once called into
tagPhrases.unlisted-by-the-sky: unlisted by every forecast above you
tagPhrases.advised-in-advance: advised in advance by someone who writes like you

tagPhrases.left-unfinished-on-purpose: leaving several things unfinished on purpose

closings: The lights go down one room at a time, in the order you walked them.
Keep the ticket. None of these futures arrived, and one of them is now yours.
The doors lock behind you. The exhibits continue without an audience, as they have for years.
